<span style="padding-left: 0.1em;">'</span>s<noinclude>{{Top|fprot}}

==Usage==
Use the template to add an apostrophe with "s" when it is surrounded by the same apostrophe symbols, which create text in ''italics'' or in '''bold'''. For example:

<pre>The ''[[Thunderer]]''{{'s}} attack failed.</pre>
The ''[[Thunderer]]''{{'s}} attack failed.

==See also==
If adding an apostrophe without an "s" to italicized or bolded text, use the {{Tlx|'}} template ([[Template:']]) instead.
